story_description: As a developer, I need onboarding and tutorial flows wired into the main app lifecycle so that first-time users see onboarding on launch, returning users see a welcome-back message, and users can access the tutorial overlay from anywhere in the app.
task: Wire Onboarding and Tutorial into BlazeApp Entry Point
task_description: Modify BlazeApp.swift and ContentView.swift to conditionally present OnboardingRootView as a fullScreenCover for first-time users, show TutorialOverlayView as an overlay when triggered, and display welcome-back toast for returning users with stored userName.
atom_description: Add @AppStorage bindings for hasCompletedOnboarding and userName, @State properties for showOnboarding, showTutorial, and showWelcomeBack, fullScreenCover modifier for OnboardingRootView, overlay modifier for TutorialOverlayView, onAppear logic to determine which flow to trigger, and environment object injection for OnboardingViewModel and TutorialViewModel.
problem_statement: The onboarding infrastructure (OnboardingRootView, OnboardingViewModel) and tutorial system (TutorialOverlayView, TutorialViewModel) exist as isolated modules. They must be wired into the main app entry point (BlazeApp.swift) to trigger automatically on first launch, resume if interrupted, show tutorial on demand, and welcome returning users by name. Without this integration, users would see the main app immediately without setup guidance.

Initial launch (returning user without name): ContentView renders normally, no toast
Onboarding active: fullScreenCover visible, ContentView behind but not interactive
Onboarding completing: fullScreenCover animates away, ContentView becomes interactive
Tutorial active: ContentView visible with TutorialOverlayView overlay, spotlight on target area
Tutorial inactive: ContentView fully interactive, no overlay
Welcome-back visible: Toast overlay at top of screen, ContentView fully interactive below
Welcome-back dismissing: Toast slides up and fades out over 0.3s
ui_interactions: User launches app (first time): OnboardingRootView appears automatically as fullScreenCover
User completes onboarding without tutorial: fullScreenCover dismisses, ContentView shown
User completes onboarding with tutorial: fullScreenCover dismisses, TutorialOverlayView appears
User presses Cmd+Shift+T: Tutorial overlay toggles on/off (if not in onboarding)
User launches app (returning with name): Welcome-back toast appears, auto-dismisses after 3s
User taps welcome-back toast: Toast dismisses immediately
User swipes down on onboarding: Nothing happens (interactiveDismissDisabled)
User clicks outside tutorial spotlight: Tutorial advances or dismisses based on TutorialViewModel
ui_copy: Tutorial keyboard shortcut hint: 'Press Cmd+Shift+T to start tutorial'
edge_cases: User force-quits during onboarding: hasCompletedOnboarding remains false, onboarding shows again on next launch
User completes onboarding then deletes preferences: hasCompletedOnboarding resets, onboarding shows again
User has userName but hasCompletedOnboarding is false (corrupted state): Onboarding takes precedence, no welcome-back
User rapidly toggles Cmd+Shift+T: showTutorial toggles each time, no race condition due to SwiftUI binding
User triggers tutorial while welcome-back toast is visible: Both can coexist, toast dismisses normally
Window loses focus during onboarding: fullScreenCover remains visible, no interaction issues
System enters low-power mode during onboarding: Animations may be reduced, functionality preserved
VoiceOver user in onboarding: fullScreenCover announces as modal, escape does not dismiss
User has empty userName after onboarding (skipped profile): No welcome-back toast on subsequent launches
failure_modes: OnboardingRootView fails to load (import error): App crashes on launch - caught by build-time check
TutorialOverlayView fails to load (import error): Tutorial button does nothing - caught by build-time check
AppStorage read fails (corrupted plist): Defaults to false/empty, triggers onboarding
@StateObject initialization fails (memory): App crashes - extremely rare, no mitigation
fullScreenCover animation hangs: UI appears frozen - covered by SwiftUI framework stability
Timer for welcome-back dismiss leaks: Toast never auto-dismisses - use weak self in closure
Environment object not injected: Child views crash on access - caught by testing
rollback_plan: Revert BlazeApp.swift to remove fullScreenCover and overlay modifiers. Delete WelcomeBackToast.swift. ContentView returns to direct rendering without conditional flows. Users who have not completed onboarding will see main app directly. AppStorage keys remain but are ignored. No data migration needed.

risk_register.blast_radius: Affects BlazeApp entry point and ContentView root. If broken, app may not launch or may show wrong UI on launch. Does not affect existing session, chat, or settings functionality once past initial launch.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If integration causes critical issues, remove fullScreenCover and overlay modifiers from BlazeApp. Users will see main app directly without onboarding. They can configure app manually via Settings. Welcome-back toast is cosmetic and can be removed without functionality loss.
